setup: In $\frac{[[num]]}{[[den]]}$, the bar is split into [[den]] equal parts and [[num]] of them are taken.

steps.say: The number underneath is the **denominator**, and its only job is to say how many equal parts the whole is cut into. Here that is [[den]].
The number on top is the **numerator**: how many of those parts are actually there. Here that is [[num]].

answer: So the fraction is read as "[[num]] out of [[den]]" — and the answer to this question is [[answer]].
